name: Location Name Dialog
description: Asks for one Project or Workspace name to rename it, or to create a Project that the exact Workspace moves into, keeping the name exactly as typed.

states: Choose Rename from a Project or Workspace menu, inspect the prefilled and selected current name under a title that also labels the field, then submit or cancel.
Clear the name and submit to see the localized reason with the field focused, then type a name and see the reason go.
Choose New Project… from a Workspace's Move to Project submenu and commit the new Project and that Workspace's membership together.

useWhen: A person renames a Project or a Workspace.
A person creates a Project while moving an existing Workspace into it.
avoidWhen: The person is creating an independent Workspace; use the one-click New Workspace action.
The name belongs to a terminal Tab; use the Tab title dialog.
invariants: The title names the only field, which takes no second label; the current name opens prefilled and selected.

The submitted name is the exact text typed. Only a name that is blank by Unicode White_Space or longer than 512 characters is refused, with a localized reason shown on submit or blur that follows the field until the name is fixed.
Cancel, Escape, the close button and backdrop dismissal commit nothing, and a Dialog whose Project or Workspace leaves closes with it.
Creating a Project from a Workspace menu commits the new Project and that Workspace's membership together.
A name never changes the Workspace's directory, launch resources, terminal identity or Git identity.
